Rapid cycling is the documented killer, in both the 2088 and 8000 manuals, in identical wording: 'If the pump is subjected to rapid cycling during normal operation, or for infrequent periods, damage may occur.' Any rule that switches one of these pumps needs hysteresis and a minimum off-time, not a bare threshold.

911-1008 (4008) notes that an RV with an Intellitec pump controller needs a 10 A or 15 A controller, and that a 7.5 A controller must be replaced or fronted by a high-current relay. The 4008's bypass adjustment screw and the pressure switch adjustment screw are two different screws with an interlock: 911-1008 warns that if full bypass pressure is reached before the shut-off setpoint, THE PUMP NEVER STOPS. A pump-run-hours reading that climbs forever is as likely to be this misadjustment as a leak.
unmappedReports: Water-system pressure. Every one of these pumps is governed by an outlet pressure setpoint the vendor states in PSI/bar (4008 bypass ~40 psi opening / ~55 psi shut-off; 5050 shut-off 60 PSI +/-2, restart 45 PSI +/-2; 2088/8000 'typically 15-20 psi below shut-off'). MetricKind has `pressure` but it is Unit::Hectopascal with display name 'Pressure', modelled for barometric readings by cabin-forecast. There is no `water-pressure` wire name, and reusing `pressure` would put a well-pump reading on the same axis as the weather., Pump run state. `pump-run-hours` exists; `pump-run-state` does not. ValueKind::RunState exists and is used by `generator-run-state`. This is the same gap already recorded in docs/catalog/lan-http.md lines 354-356 for the Victron 4700 pump register, now seen from a second direction., Pressure-switch cycle count. `cycle-count` is Unit::Count but its doc comment ties it to battery cycles. The 2088/8000 manuals make rapid cycling ('ON/OFF WITHIN 2 seconds') the named failure mode, so cycles-per-hour is the diagnostic a cabin owner would want and there is no wire name for it., Thermal-breaker trip. 2088/8000/5050/3200 motors are thermally protected and self-resetting; a trip is a real degraded state with no MetricKind and no `clear-fault` path (nothing to clear it through).
